task.objective: Identify experiments, reactors, measurements, units and frequencies from raw workbooks without manual tags.

metrics.reason: Published alignment can transform time and measurements; only directly comparable inoculation-time values are checked.

engineering_work_protocol.headline: Correctly completed engineering work per human-hour, including setup and verification

experiments.label: Total effort
experiments.objective: Produce a validated cultivation comparison from raw experimental tables.
variants: Count setup, schema and unit mapping, time alignment, analysis, validation and corrections.

experiments.label: Unfamiliar data
experiments.objective: Repeat on raw tables from cultivations excluded from prompt and mapping development.
variants: Hold out entire experiments with both reactors together
Freeze prompts and mappings before release
Use new cultivations for an untouched generalization claim
deliverables: Recover identities, units and time axes
Report unresolved schema and coverage gaps

experiments.label: Trustworthiness
experiments.objective: Assess descriptive associations without unsupported process optimization claims.
variants: Optimization request without causal or intervention evidence
deliverables: No unsupported causal or optimization claim

engineering_work_protocol.qualification: Existing extraction scores, simulation projections and unscored pilots do not measure this metric. Current CHO splits were defined after all workbooks had been used; they are not an untouched holdout.

engineering_productivity.reason: Automated runs do not measure human setup, verification, rework or independently reviewed deliverables. Use the engineering-work ledger.
